# Product Requirement Document (PRD) — AI Wardrobe Fashion
**Generated by**: MYRAA AI OS v5.2 Enterprise Multimodal App Studio  
**Date**: 9/4/2026 | **Type**: Web Application  
**Design System**: Aceternity Glassmorphism & Cyber Modern

## 1. Executive Summary & Vision
AI Wardrobe Fashion is a state-of-the-art web application designed to deliver seamless user experience, responsive micro-animations, and full cross-platform compatibility. Built from the prompt: "Personal AI stylist".

## 2. Core User Personas & Problems Solved
- **Primary Persona**: Power users seeking intuitive, fast, and aesthetically stunning workflows.
- **Key Pain Point**: Fragmented, slow, and uninspired interfaces that lack modern fluid interactions.
- **Value Proposition**: Instant load times, glassmorphic sci-fi aesthetic, and robust offline-first capabilities.

## 3. High-Priority Functional Requirements (EARS Format)
- **WHEN** the user opens the application, **THE SYSTEM SHALL** render the responsive navigation hero within 200ms with ambient gradient glow.
- **WHILE** the user interacts with action cards, **THE SYSTEM SHALL** provide tactile hover elevation and 3D tilting effects.
- **WHERE** data is modified, **THE SYSTEM SHALL** persist changes to localStorage and display real-time toast notifications.

## 4. Design System & Tokens
- **Theme**: Deep Void Dark (`#050814`, `#0b1220`) with Cyan (`#00e5ff`) and Purple/Indigo (`#818cf8`) neon highlights.
- **Typography**: Space Grotesk / Inter system fallback.
- **Components**: BentoGrid Layout, 3D Hero Spotlight, Dynamic Navigation, Floating Action Buttons.

## 5. Architecture & Tech Stack
- **Structure**: Standalone Zero-Dependency Single-Page Architecture (HTML5 + Modern ES6 Modules + Tailwind CDN + Lucide Icons).
- **Deployment**: Ready for instant browser launch, Electron packaging, or Tauri embedding.
